title: Therapeutic Closing Charge: Calculation Basis — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — therapeutic closing charge, basis questions answered.**

**What is the therapeutic closing charge?** The therapeutic closing charge is the therapeutic closing entry's charged days times the therapeutic closing daily charge, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

**Which entry does it price?** The therapeutic closing entry: the closing entry of a released Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold that carries more than one resident-private entry — the resident-private entry with the latest last day on the reservation, when it is not also the opening entry. A reservation carries one resident-private entry per service month, so the therapeutic closing entry is a single entry, its days as booked counted net of any of them reversed against it.

**Which days are charged?** The therapeutic closing entry's charged days are its days less any of them held before the transfer notice was delivered, those days being the entry's days dated before the delivery date, or all of its days where no transfer notice is on file. A transfer notice counts from the earlier of its latest delivery to the resident and its latest delivery to the representative; where it has been delivered to only one of them, that delivery is the one counted.

**At what rate?** The therapeutic closing daily charge is the schedule daily rate for the tier of the room held, the prior schedule pricing the entry's days dated before the current schedule's schedule date and the current schedule the rest. The prior and current schedule rates of each room tier that price the therapeutic closing charge are the figures this schedule restates from the private pay schedule, the current schedule taking effect on its schedule date, 2026-07-01.

| Tier of the room held | Prior schedule daily rate (days dated before 2026-07-01), USD | Current schedule daily rate (2026-07-01 onward), USD |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

The current-schedule days are the calendar days from 2026-07-01 through the entry's last day, never more than the entry's days and none where the entry ends before 2026-07-01; every other day of the entry is a prior-schedule day.

**How are the figures put together?** The figures are combined in this order: each schedule rate is first taken to the applicable percent, any per-day credit is then subtracted from that reduced rate, and each resulting daily charge is multiplied by the charged days it applies to; the days not charged at the start of the entry are its first days, the days not charged at the end of the entry are its last days, and the current-schedule days are counted back from the entry's last day; the charge is the sum, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** A closing entry of 1–9 August, 9 days, none reversed, in a Private Long-Term Care Room, with the transfer notice delivered in July before the entry began: every one of the 9 days is charged; all 9 fall on or after 2026-07-01 and are current-schedule days. The charge is 9 days at 436.00: 3,924.00.

**And where no transfer notice is on file?** Then all of the entry's days are days held before the notice, and none is charged.
